svg.title: 35mmIsle — a forgotten camera, a familiar island
svg.desc: An anime-inspired beach in warm afternoon light. A weathered silver and charcoal film SLR rests in the sand beside its loose woven strap and a seashell. A volcanic island and glowing crater are reflected in the curved teal glass of its lens. Turquoise surf, distant islands, soft clouds and overhanging palm fronds surround the scene. Original cream and deep-teal 35mmIsle lettering sits in the upper-left corner.
